_doc: Sửa tay theo từ#loại (mọi bộ) hoặc từ#loại@bộ (một bộ). Trường: ipa, ipaUS, vi, def, ex, col, syn, level. Nghĩa 1 = nghĩa thông dụng nhất (docs/LEXICON.md). Áp bằng: node scripts/build-lexicon.mjs --write

present#adj.def: being in a particular place; existing or happening now

record#n.def: a written account of something that is kept so that it can be looked at later; the best result ever achieved

impression#n.vi: ấn tượng; lượt hiển thị (quảng cáo)

podium#n.def: a small raised platform that a person stands on to speak, conduct music or receive a prize

step#n@ngsl2.def: one of a series of things that you do to achieve something; a movement of putting one foot in front of the other

step#n@ngsl1.def: one of a series of things that you do to achieve something; a movement of putting one foot in front of the other

unreal#adj.ex: Winning the national prize felt completely unreal to her.

administrate#v.ex: Volunteers help to administrate the programme in rural areas.

advertisement#n@education.ex: I saw an advertisement for a cheap phone on TV.

ward#n.vi: phòng bệnh, khoa (bệnh viện); phường (khu hành chính)

work#v@ngsl1.def: to do a job, especially one you are paid for

start#v@ngsl1.def: to begin doing something, or to begin to happen

set#v@ngsl1.def: to put something in a place; to decide on a time, price, rule, etc.

open#v@ngsl1.def: to move something so that it is no longer closed

close#v@ngsl1.def: to move something so that it is no longer open; to shut

hope#v@ngsl1.def: to want something to happen and think that it may happen

fall#v@ngsl2.def: to drop down from a higher place, or to stop standing and go down to the ground

share#v@ngsl2.def: to have or use something together with other people

cover#v@ngsl2.def: to put something over something else to protect or hide it; to deal with a subject

bear#v@ngsl2.def: to accept or deal with something unpleasant

focus#v@ngsl2.def: to give all your attention to one thing

catch#v@ngsl3.def: to take hold of something moving; to get on a bus, train or plane

contribute#v@ngsl5.def: to give money, help or ideas together with other people

elect#v@ngsl6.def: to choose someone for a position by voting

fascinate#v@ngsl8.def: to attract or interest someone very much

withdraw#v@ngsl8.def: to take money out of a bank account; to move back or away

injure#v@ngsl9.def: to hurt a person or animal physically

stimulate#v@ngsl10.def: to make something more active or encourage it to grow

power#n@ngsl2.def: electricity used in homes and machines; also the ability to control people or events

conclude#v@ngsl5.def: to decide that something is true after looking at the facts; to end

golden#adj@ngsl10.def: having the colour of gold; made of gold
golden#adj@ngsl10.vi: vàng óng, màu vàng; bằng vàng

theoretical#adj.vi: thuộc lý thuyết, mang tính lý thuyết

nocturnal#adj.vi: hoạt động về đêm, sống về đêm

assignment#n.vi: bài tập được giao; nhiệm vụ, công việc được giao

brand loyalty#n.vi: lòng trung thành với thương hiệu

panel#n.vi: hội đồng, ban (chuyên gia); tấm (ván, kim loại)
